name: ProcessEmailMessages
description: Process email messages such as Move, delete, or mark as unread emails using IMAP and MailKit
author: @gaurav

fields.name: __CredentialId__GeneralCredential
fields.label: Email Credential
fields.description: The Email credential containing valid email and app password which is used to authenticate user requests.

fields.name: Operation
fields.label: Operation
fields.description: Specifies the action to perform on the email messages.

selectOptions.label: Delete
selectOptions.description: Deletes email messages from the server.

selectOptions.label: MoveToFolder
selectOptions.description: Moves email messages to a specified mail folder.

fields.name: MessageUidsObj
fields.label: Message Uids
fields.description: Unique identifiers ID of the email messages from the IMAP server

fields.name: ImapServer
fields.label: Imap Server
fields.description: The IMAP server address (e.g., imap.gmail.com).Process email messages over the Internet

fields.name: ImapPort
fields.label: Imap Port
fields.description: The port number used to connect to the IMAP server. Default is 993.

fields.name: MailFolder
fields.label: MailFolder
fields.description: The destination mail folder. Required when Operation is set to Move to Mail Folder.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns the response data from mailkit after process the email.
